question: Does the measured clock-origin and schedule-phase correction, alone or together, make the model agree with the phone window by window?

method.cellRule: presses by the sched rule on the update clock (image-pinned for a traced night, no landing latency), the whole schedule shifted by deltaMs; dropMs starts a rebuilt office clock at the first captured frame at or after that image time; timerRate r scales every office update timer delta by (1 + r)
method.refineRule: No local search: the four cells per night are the predeclared control and measured corrections.

verdictCfg.matchRule: a cell matches when unplayed = 0, compared >= matchMinCompared and agree = compared: every phone-read window the model played agrees
verdictCfg.improveRule: a night improves when its best cell's agreeing windows (count) reach the control's plus ceil(improveMargin x the control's compared windows); a cell that dies early and agrees on a bare majority of the few windows it played does not improve anything
verdictCfg.consistencyRule: matching cells across nights are consistent when every pair's deltaMs, timerRate and dropMs differ by at most their configured margins
verdictCfg.statusRule: ALIGNMENT_CELLS_FOUND if any measured-reference cell matches; IMPROVED_NOT_ALIGNED if none matches but some night improves; NO_PHASE_RATE_ALIGNMENT otherwise. No status promotes MODEL_ONLY results to trace-equivalence.

limitations: Model-side sweep only: no rebuild run and no phone run; the rebuild shares the model side of every retained first disagreement, but a found cell is a candidate until confirmed in the rebuild.
A uniform rate and a constant phase are one-parameter families, not a full timing topology: intermittent jank deficits, per-press jitter and lost contacts are not in this grid.
deltaMs shifts the whole schedule, keeping the press file shape; the phone press stream itself was not changed.
A night with no frame trace (twin-01) cannot separate press phase from timer rate and sweeps deltaMs only on a constant 60 Hz clock.
Phone windows are the retained right-eyehole readers' codes; they cannot see Balloon Boy, Mangle or the vent Toys, and full-04 window 3's occupant is unlabelled.
Matching cells would be necessary, not sufficient, for equivalence: the outcome must also agree, and one night at one cell is not a trace-equivalence record.
